description: This header file defines a utility class `dmUtility` with static methods for string and query parsing operations such as splitting queries, checking suffixes, trimming wildcards and property names, parsing multiset values, and splitting strings. It appears to be part of a larger project related to device management or data modeling, providing common utility functions used across the project.

classes.name: dmUtility
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string parsing and manipulation related to device management and data modeling operations

methods.name: void splitQuery(char const * query,char * parameter)
methods.description: Extracts the filename or last component from a query string by locating the last dot or backslash and appending it to the parameter buffer

methods.name: bool has_suffix(const std::string & str,const std::string & suffix)
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix

methods.name: bool isWildcard(char const * s)
methods.description: Checks if a given string ends with a dot, indicating a wildcard

methods.name: std::string trimWildcard(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the trailing dot from a string if present

methods.name: std::string trimProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Trims the property name from a dot-separated string, returning the substring before the last dot

methods.name: std::string trimPropertyName(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Extracts the property name after the last dot in a dot-separated string

methods.name: std::string trimSetProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Trims set property syntax from a string, especially when it includes braces for multiple values

methods.name: bool parseMultisetValue(std::string const & s,std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>> & nameVals)
methods.description: Parses a multiset string in the form `{key1=value1,key2=value2}` into a vector of key-value pairs

methods.name: void splitString(std::string const & s,char delim,std::vector<std::string> & out)
methods.description: Splits a string by a specified delimiter and stores the resulting tokens into a vector
